outcome: Percentage of neonates with TSH >5 mIU/L
cohort: The study included postnatal mother-neonate dyads from a tertiary care center in Delhi, India, between November 2015 to November 2016.
finding: Despite higher rates of maternal iodine insufficiency and excess in neonates with elevated TSH, the study found no overall correlation between neonatal TSH values and maternal urinary iodine concentration.
